_comment: Least-privilege IAM policy examples for Invoice Processing Pipeline secrets access.

data_extractor_lambda_role_policy._comment: Policy for the data-extractor Lambda — needs OpenRouter and LangFuse secrets

Statement._note: Use specific CMK ARN if not using default aws/secretsmanager key

warehouse_writer_lambda_role_policy._comment: warehouse-writer Lambda — only needs Slack webhook for error notifications

tiff_converter_lambda_role_policy._comment: tiff-to-png-converter Lambda — no secrets needed; uses IAM role for S3/SQS only

invoice_classifier_lambda_role_policy._comment: invoice-classifier Lambda — no external API secrets needed

rotation_lambda_role_policy._comment: Policy for a custom rotation Lambda — needs to read/write the secret being rotated

anti_patterns._comment: Never use these — included as documentation of what to avoid

too_broad_wildcard._reason: Grants full secrets admin access to the Lambda — violates least-privilege

account_level_get._reason: Allows reading ALL secrets in the account — scope to specific ARNs instead

terraform_iam_example._comment: Terraform data source and resource for attaching this policy to a Lambda role
terraform_iam_example._code: data 'aws_iam_policy_document' 'data_extractor_secrets' { statement { sid = 'ReadOpenRouterSecret' effect = 'Allow' actions = ['secretsmanager:GetSecretValue'] resources = [aws_secretsmanager_secret.openrouter_api_key.arn] } ... } resource 'aws_iam_role_policy' 'data_extractor_secrets' { name = 'data-extractor-secrets-policy' role = aws_iam_role.data_extractor_lambda.id policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.data_extractor_secrets.json }
